elaine: Perf alert from perfwatcher — p95/p99 for streamingGenerate increased ~3-8% across several clusters overnight. Graph: https://perf.internal.redwood/p/abc123 (screenshot posted)
perf-bot: nightly-run summary: select-kernel benchmark regressed 6.2% vs baseline. Job: perf/select-kernel-v2. Link: https://ci.redwood/1234
raj: saw similar on canary around 01:10. tail latency bump coincides with kernel_selector change in merge 2148f2d (PR #782).
tomas: running a bisect now. command: /bisect --since=2148f2d --metric=p99 --branch=main (will post artifacts)
ci-bot: bisect job started — gathering perf traces across candidate merges. Current suspects: PR#782, PR#779, PR#775
tomas: bisect pinned PR#782 as likely culprit — local repro: ./perf_tools/bench_select_kernels --seed=42 --seq=1024 -> ~6% slower vs baseline
perf-bot: flamegraphs uploaded: https://perf.internal.redwood/runs/fg-2149001234 . Notable: increased time in kernel_dispatch_generic and memcpy hotspots
sasha: PR#782 touched kernel_selector heuristics and added an aggressive fallback path for N>2048 sequences — might be misclassifying shorter batches as long ones
